scope: Only cal/val features, frozen model and independent synthetic prototype bank; no test data, actual private truth, world reconstruction or fitting.

formulas.band_quality: B_i,e = sum_p span_p * O_k(p) * C_k(p) * H_i(t_p) / T_e; slot-boundary <=120-second mesh
formulas.science_quality: Q_i,e = sum_p span_p * O_k(p) * C_k(p) * E_k(p) * directional_attenuation_i(t_p) * H_i(t_p) / T_e; slot and per-path event boundaries then <=120-second mesh
formulas.terrain_compatibility: deduplicated coarse terrain direction set of bank path == terrain direction set in current public query tail
formulas.directional_weather_compatibility: deduplicated non-ALL weather/rocket notices from path events overlapping first slot == current public query non-ALL weather/rocket notices
formulas.incompatible_mass: sum_k p(k|x) * 1[path k incompatible with public evidence]
formulas.report_compatibility: same-timestamp true OR false report => unrepaired active fault flag in current slot == 0
formulas.force_close_compatibility: current ALL rain OR storm => first-slot open flag == 0, conditional on this experiment's frozen reference weather config

qualification.terrain: Permanent terrain sectors are all announced on the opening bulletin, with coarse directions deduplicated; all are retained in every five-slot path.
qualification.directional_weather: Exact non-ALL notice-set condition uses this experiment's slot-aligned official generated event spans. ALL weather events are not stored as path event records and cannot be audited by this equality.
qualification.force_close: This is a conditional reference-config check, not a universal all-task-card rule. Numeric weather generation config is absent from initialize.
qualification.interpretation: Incompatible mass is a support violation relative to public evidence. Zero matching classes cannot be fixed by a probability hard mask without extending or transforming the dictionary.

source_review.future_leak: No actual future truth use found in PublicHistory inputs or candidate_fields assignment. Host future path is confined to supervision/projection/realized values. All-path scoring groups each prototype's event-boundary signature independently, avoiding host truth changing prototype quadrature.
source_review.five_slots: Slot-origin-relative event relocation and separate band/science meshes match reviewed official operator for <=3600-second night-clipped candidates. Existing operator_gate: 1743 checks, max error 8.881784197001252e-16; that gate does not validate posterior support.
source_review.report: path restoration divides only repaired fault multipliers, clips E to 1 and preserves quake/jitter. Predictor has same-timestamp healthy support mask. evaluate.py:79 excludes these immediate-post-report rows from the regret-query subset.
source_review.assignment_scope: evaluate.py:19 uses source field-0 assignments without zero-offset nominal-hit filtering. Public-design cache contains 2 such target misses among 13404 L1 assigned candidates and 2 among 14900 L2 candidates; predicted path values presume all candidates hit. Host actual offset affects realized value only, as declared.
source_review.source_lock: Reviewed sources match SOURCE_LOCK. SAMPLING_LOCK's initial physical_operator hash differs; SOURCE_LOCK records its authorized equivalence-preserving amendment.
